The «Vulcan-M» («Malyuk») is a Ukrainian bullpup assault rifle developed by Interproinvest through a deep modernization of the AK platform, adopted into service by the Armed Forces of Ukraine in 2017. The weapon is equipped with Picatinny rails, an ambidextrous fire selector, and an improved trigger mechanism yielding a rate of fire up to 700 RPM, while a modified barrel with increased rifling lines ensures high accuracy. 
 
 %c[d_orange]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] Suppressor: ATG 
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] Scopes: «Picatinny», «Weaver» rail
